subject: Renewal: 50% capacity increase — billing owner, PO & tax evidence
messages:
From: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@orionlabs.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orionlabs.com
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & expansion — PO issuance and tax form

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the renewal package. We're ready to move forward with the 50% capacity increase tied to our annual renewal (ORN-4821), but procurement needs to change the invoice recipient and issue a PO before we hit the go-ahead. Can you confirm the invoice recipient name and the address we should use for the PO? Also: our tax team needs clarification whether Redwood requires a W-9 or W-8 for our parent entity (US-based with EU billing). I've attached the signed SOW for your reference.

Attachments: Signed_SOW_ORN-4821.pdf

Sam Rivera
Head of Procurement, Orion Labs
sam.rivera@orionlabs.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

On behalf of Finance: finance@orionlabs.com
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@orionlabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — PO issuance and tax form

Hi Sam — thanks, great to hear Orion is expanding with us. Quick checklist so procurement has everything they need:

- Invoice recipient (how we should render it on invoices): Orion Labs, Inc.
  Billing address: 210 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Preferred payment terms: Net30 by default; we can accept Net60 on this renewal with a PO and an updated signed addendum (we'll need legal sign-off).
- PO instructions: please include Deal ID ORN-4821 and send PO to billing@redwood.com. We typically accept the PO as a PDF or Word doc.
- Tax evidence: Redwood requires a completed W-9 for US entities; if you have an EU entity billing, we need a W-8BEN-E or local VAT registration evidence.

I've looped in Marissa (your account lead) to coordinate the commercial terms and Connor from finance to accept the PO and send the addendum.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement issues PO referencing ORN-4821 to billing@redwood.com (attach your W-9).
2) Marissa will prepare the short Net60 addendum if you confirm Net60.
3) Connor will confirm invoicing cadence once PO is received.

Marissa, Connor — can you confirm acceptance of Net60 for this renewal and whether a debit schedule (monthly/quarterly) is preferable for Orion?

Thanks,

— Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@orionlabs.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orionlabs.com, finance@orionlabs.com
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — PO issuance and tax form

Thanks Hannah — confirming we'll issue a PO today. A few clarifications from our finance team:

- We'll push Net60 for this renewal given the higher commit; please route the invoice to BillingOps (billingops@orionlabs.com) as the payor.
- PO number will be ORN-PO-12345; they'll send Orion_PO_12345.docx to billing@redwood.com.
- Our legal still needs the short addendum language (Net60 + capacity uplift) — Marissa, can you send a one-page amendment for signature?
- Tax evidence: attaching the group's W-9 (Orion_W9.pdf). We also have EU VAT registration for our EU subsidiary; is that needed now or only if you invoice the EU entity?

Attachments: Orion_W9.pdf

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we'll aim to have the PO in by EOD PST.

Sam

Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — PO issuance and tax form

Sam / Hannah — quick update from legal & finance:

- Legal has drafted a one-page amendment reflecting Net60 and the +50% capacity uplift; sending via DocuSign now (link below). Please review and e-sign.
- Connor confirmed Finance can accept Net60 provided the PO arrives and the addendum is signed; they prefer monthly invoicing for large commits to smooth cashflow.
- Billing will accept the PO ORN-PO-12345 (we received a copy attached) and Orion_W9.pdf is recorded.
- Regarding EU VAT: only needed if Redwood invoices your EU legal entity directly. For now, we'll invoice Orion Labs, Inc. in the US per the W-9. If you later change the invoice recipient to the EU subsidiary, we'll re-open tax evidence and VAT registration.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/tx/orn-4821-sign

Next actions for Orion:
1) Sign the DocuSign amendment.
2) Procurement sends the official PO to billing@redwood.com (if not already delivered).
3) Finance will schedule monthly invoices starting with the first invoice after the addendum effective date.

Thanks — excited to ramp this up. Marissa will be your primary commercial contact during the onboarding phase.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
